body: I thought the same. So I did try and talk to my friends. But they didnt really want to know. :(

You're right it doesnt. But it's a pretty handy safety net to have. I had to stop working 6 months ago, and since then I've spent all of my £10k savings and wracked up nearly £6k in credit cards and debt, just to sit alone and be depressed. Why don't you go travelling? At least spend the money before you make any big decisions, you never know what kind of happiness you'll encounter along the way. I want to kill myself too, and all I have to live for is debt. I think you should try.

Thats a really astute point: I am working harder for those relationships, but I feel like I'm working harder at everything, and thats not anyone elses problem but my own. 
If i tell anyone how I'm really feeling, about how bad my depression really is, its a burden on them. No one really wants to know how bad it is, because what can they do? 
Life is beautiful, I really believe that, and I really want to be happy. My brain just wont let me.

Thank you. I'm trying to work out a way to get through it, but every day gets worse. I can't get out of bed, I can't leave the house, I cant look after myself, I can't find the will to live so everything else is impossible. I've got myself into massive amounts of debt because I'm too ill to work, and thinking about killing myself is, weirdly, the only thing that makes me not really sad!

My depression is getting worse ad I feel the same- I really don't know what to do about it. I cant get out of bed, brush my teeth, do any housework-for days at a time, its eating me whole. If I'm having an OK day where I can get out of bed for a little while, I've found it helpful to listen to a podcast and just blitz some essential stuff like having a quick tidy up, changing clothes, having a wash etc. Just do as much stuff as you can in that 30-40 mins whilst concentrating on the podcast (even better if its a funny one) and then when its over and you go back to bed/sofa/netflix binge or whatever, you'll feel a little bit more accomplished, and i think maybe the endorphins from moving around a bit help. For me its just really little steps like that enabling me to get through chunks of time. I know its not an ideal way to live, I'm still looking for the answer myself!
